answer_2.quote: We evaluate the model by matching the predicted API call against the ground truth. ... We report the overall accuracy considering both API name and arguments (Correctness) as the main metric, together with the percentage of examples with valid API calls and no syntax/formatting errors (Wellformedness) and the percentage of examples that correctly choose to use the ground-truth API (API Match).

answer_3.quote: We perform filtering by using GPT-4 to judge the validity of each example... For APIs that accept free natural language inputs, we use ChatGPT to judge the correctness of the predicted API arguments.
